info.title: Release Server API
info.description:
Download server for released software. Products are published as releases (version, release date, change log) for one or more platforms (operating system and architecture).

**Public endpoints** (no authentication):
- `GET /artifacts` lists all products
- `GET /artifacts/{product}/info` lists the releases of a product (filter, sort and paging)
- `GET /artifacts/{product}/{os}/{architecture}/{version}` downloads a release
- `GET /artifacts/{product}/{os}/{architecture}/latest` downloads the latest release

All other endpoints maintain the server and **require authentication** (HTTP Basic).

Errors are returned as problem details (RFC 7807) with the fields title, status and detail.

get.description:
Returns the file of the release for the given platform. The file name is sent in the
Content-Disposition header. Range requests are supported, so interrupted downloads can be resumed.
            
Example:
            
    GET /artifacts/example-product/windows/x64/1.2.0

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: The identifier of the product (case-sensitive).

parameters.name: os
parameters.description: The operating system, e.g. "windows", "linux" or "any".

parameters.name: architecture
parameters.description: The architecture, e.g. "x64", "x86", "arm64" or "any".

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: The version, e.g. "1.2.0" or "2.0.0-beta".

404.description: The release does not exist for this platform.

206.description: A part of the file (range request).

put.summary: Uploads a release for one platform (requires authentication)
put.description:
**Requires authentication** (HTTP Basic). Not intended for public use.

The request body is multipart/form-data with the field "artifact": a ZIP file (max. 500 MB) containing
            
- deployment.json: { "artifactFileName": "setup.exe", "releaseNotesFileName": "releaseNotes.json" }
- the release notes file: { "releaseDate": "2026-01-31", "isPreviewRelease": false, "isSecurityPatch": false,
  "changes": { "en": [ { "added": [], "fixed": [], "breaking": [], "deprecated": [] } ] } }
- the artifact file itself
            
Operating system metadata in the ZIP file is ignored and not stored: macOS ("__MACOSX/", "._*",
".DS_Store") and Windows ("Thumbs.db", "ehthumbs.db", "desktop.ini", "$RECYCLE.BIN/").
            
An existing release with the same product, platform and version is replaced. Names may contain
letters, digits, '-', '_' and '.'.

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: The identifier of the product.

parameters.name: os
parameters.description: The operating system of the release, e.g. "windows", "linux" or "any".

parameters.name: architecture
parameters.description: The architecture of the release, e.g. "x64", "arm64" or "any".

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: The version of the release, e.g. "1.2.0" or "2.0.0-beta".

artifact.description: The ZIP file with deployment.json, release notes and artifact.

400.description: The file is missing or invalid, or a name is not allowed.

401.description: Authentication is missing or the credentials are wrong.

get.description:
Returns the file of the newest release (highest version) for the given platform. Pre-releases are
included: a pre-release is delivered if it has a higher version than the newest release. Use
GET /artifacts/{product}/info to find out which version this is.
            
Example:
            
    GET /artifacts/example-product/windows/x64/latest

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: The identifier of the product (case-sensitive).

parameters.name: os
parameters.description: The operating system, e.g. "windows", "linux" or "any".

parameters.name: architecture
parameters.description: The architecture, e.g. "x64", "x86", "arm64" or "any".

200.description: The file of the latest release.

404.description: The product has no release for this platform.

206.description: A part of the file (range request).

get.summary: Creates a backup of all products and returns it as ZIP file (requires authentication)
get.description:
**Requires authentication** (HTTP Basic). Not intended for public use.

The backup is also kept on the server (the newest backups, see the setting BackupRetentionCount).
It can be restored with PUT /artifacts/restore.

401.description: Authentication is missing or the credentials are wrong.

put.summary: Replaces all products by the content of a backup (requires authentication)
put.description:
**Requires authentication** (HTTP Basic). Not intended for public use.

The backup is extracted and verified first (structure, meta information, release notes and files).
The existing data is only replaced if the backup is valid; otherwise it stays unchanged and the
response describes the problems. Every release needs its deployment.json, release notes and
artifact file; additional files and directories (e.g. stored by previous versions) are kept.

backupFile.description: The backup (ZIP file created by GET /artifacts/backup), sent as multipart/form-data.

400.description: The file is missing or the backup is invalid (the existing data is unchanged).

401.description: Authentication is missing or the credentials are wrong.

get.summary: Returns statistics of the server (requires authentication)
get.description:
**Requires authentication** (HTTP Basic). Not intended for public use.

Disk usage in MB (total size and free space of the disk, space used by the artifacts) and the number
of products and artifacts (releases per platform).

401.description: Authentication is missing or the credentials are wrong.

get.summary: Lists the releases of a product.
get.description:
Returns the releases of a product with version, release date, supported platforms and change log.
The releases can be filtered by platform and version, sorted by version and paged.
            
A platform consists of an operating system and an architecture, e.g. "windows/x64" or "linux/arm64".
To download a release, use the version and one of its platforms:
`GET /artifacts/{product}/{os}/{architecture}/{version}`.
            
Examples:
            
    GET /artifacts/example-product/info
    GET /artifacts/example-product/info?operatingSystems=windows&architectures=x64,any
    GET /artifacts/example-product/info?sortOrder=descending&limit=1   (latest release)
    GET /artifacts/example-product/info?version=1.2.0                     (one release)
            
Pre-releases have a version suffix (e.g. 2.0.0-beta) and "isPreviewRelease": true. A release without
suffix is newer than its pre-releases.
            
"artifacts" lists the downloadable file of every platform with file name, size in bytes, SHA-256
checksum (lower case hex) and download URL. The checksum of files uploaded before version 1.1 is
calculated by the server in the background and is null until then.

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: The identifier of the product (case-sensitive), as listed by GET /artifacts.

parameters.name: architectures
parameters.description: Only releases for these architectures (comma separated or repeated parameter), e.g. "x64,arm64". Default: all.

parameters.name: operatingSystems
parameters.description: Only releases for these operating systems (comma separated or repeated parameter), e.g. "windows,linux". Default: all.

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Order of the releases by version: "descending" (newest first, default) or "ascending".

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Paging: maximum number of releases in the response (default 50).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Paging: number of releases to skip (default 0). The response contains "nextOffset" if more releases exist.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Only the release with exactly this version, e.g. "1.2.0" or "2.0.0-beta".

fixed: Fixed a security issue in the login.
Fixed a security issue in the login.
Fixed a security issue in the login.

404.description: The product does not exist or no release matches the filter.

get.description:
Returns the identifiers of all products. Use an identifier with GET /artifacts/{product}/info to get
its releases.

put.summary: Uploads a release for several platforms (package) (requires authentication)
put.description:
**Requires authentication** (HTTP Basic). Not intended for public use.

The request body is multipart/form-data with the field "package": a ZIP file (max. 1 GB) containing a
folder with package.json and the files of all platforms:
            
    {
      "identifier": "example-product",
      "version": "1.2.0",
      "releaseNotes": { "releaseDate": "2026-01-31", "changes": { "en": [ { "added": ["..."] } ] } },
      "deployments": {
        "windows/x64": "files/setup-x64.exe",
        "linux/arm64": "files/app-arm64.tar.gz",
        "any/any": "files/documentation.zip"
      }
    }
            
Operating system metadata in the ZIP file is ignored and not stored: macOS ("__MACOSX/", "._*",
".DS_Store") and Windows ("Thumbs.db", "ehthumbs.db", "desktop.ini", "$RECYCLE.BIN/").
            
If the version already exists, the upload is rejected unless force=true is set.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Replace the release if this version of the product already exists.

package.description: The ZIP file with package.json and the files of all platforms.

200.description: The release was stored for all platforms.

400.description: The file is missing or invalid, a name is not allowed, or the version already exists (title "Conflict").

401.description: Authentication is missing or the credentials are wrong.

fileName.description: Gets or sets the file name of the download.

size.description: Gets or sets the size of the file in bytes.

sha256.description:
Gets or sets the SHA-256 checksum of the file as lower case hex string. It is null for existing
files until the server has calculated it (shortly after the start).

downloadUrl.description: Gets or sets the relative URL to download the file.

ArtifactInformation.description: The downloadable file of a release for one platform.

platforms.description: Gets or sets the platforms, which are affected by the changes.

added.description: Gets or sets the added features of the release.

fixed.description: Gets or sets the issues, that have been fixed

breaking.description: Gets or sets the breaking changes of the release.

deprecated.description: Gets or sets the deprecated components.

ChangeSet.description: Provides the information of the code changes of a certain release.

totalSize.description: Gets or sets the total disk size of the server.

usedDiskSpace.description: Gets or sets the space used by the server.

availableFreeSpace.description: Gets or sets the available disk space on the server.

DiskUsage.description: Provides information about the disk usage in the server.

Platform.description: Represents a platform that consists of combination of operating system and architecture.

identifier.description: Gets the identifier of the product

releases.description: Gets the available releases of the product

totalReleaseCount.description: Gets the total count of releases for the product.

nextOffset.description: Gets the offset of the next release.

ProductInformation.description: Provides a list of product information for several artifacts.

ProductList.description: Provides the information of the available platforms for a specific artifact.

versionNumber.description: Gets or sets the version number of the artifact.

versionSuffix.description: Gets or sets the version suffix of the artifact (e.g. -alpha, -beta).

ProductVersion.description:
Provides the information of an artifact product version and implements several operations for
the ReleaseServer.WebApi.Models.ProductVersion.

releaseDate.description: Gets or sets the release date (required).

changes.description: Gets or sets the code / product changes with this release (required).

platforms.description: Gets or sets the platforms this release is available for.

artifacts.description:
Gets or sets the downloadable files of the release (one per platform, same order as Platforms).
Added in version 1.1; it is serialized last, so the existing properties keep their order.

ReleaseInformation.description: Provides a list of product information for several artifacts.

numberOfProducts.description: Gets or sets the number of products.

numberOfArtifacts.description: Gets or sets the number of artifacts.

Statistics.description: Provides statistical information about the server.

basic.description: Input your username and password to access this API
